t: This is the mausoleum of the Hartley family, in Highgate Western Cemetery. It was made by Patrick MacDowell, an Irish-born British sculptor who worked through the nineteenth century. A mausoleum like this is a family's final statement in stone, and here that statement was entrusted to a sculptor rather than only a builder. Take a moment to look closely at the carving and the overall form, which carry his hand.
